label: terminal: new terminal at file dir
copy: copy as mention
command: f=$(printenv ZED_FILE | sed "s|^$HOME/|~/|"); sel=$(printenv ZED_SELECTED_TEXT); if [ -z "$sel" ]; then m="@$f"; else n=$(printf '%s' "$sel" | wc -l | tr -d ' '); if [ "$n" -gt 0 ]; then m="@$f#L$ZED_ROW-$((ZED_ROW + n))"; else m="@$f#L$ZED_ROW"; fi; fi; printf '%s' "$m" | pbcopy
